generatedWith: Built-in image_gen tool, new six-column texture atlas using ancient paintings as content references and current game screenshot as style reference
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production-ready texture atlas for the painted surfaces of a six-leaf Tang-inspired folding screen in a 3D illustrated courtyard game.
References: images 1–4 are CONTENT references, ancient tall flower-and-long-tailed-bird paintings. Preserve their recognizable composition and subjects, not their blur, damage, stains, faded brown cast, or photographic mounting. Image 5 is the GAME STYLE/PALETTE reference only; do not draw its architecture or UI.
Output: a wide 2:1 flat rectangular image, six EXACTLY equal-width portrait paintings laid out side-by-side in a single row. Each portrait occupies one sixth of the total width and the entire height. All six are upright, front-on, with the same level top/bottom and consistent uniform pale ivory paper background. This is a flat surface texture, NOT a photograph or render of a folding screen. No physical frames, hinges, border matting, gaps, gutters, numbers or captions. The game will add its own wood frames.
Content: six distinct but coordinated vertical flower-and-bird compositions redrawn from the supplied ancient paintings. Each leaf has a slender branching flowering tree extending through its upper two thirds, small butterflies or flying insects, a graceful long-tailed pheasant-like bird in the lower quarter standing on a small stylized rock, sparse grass and low plants at the foot. The branches should be organic and asymmetrical. Alternate the birds' facing directions to make three loosely mirrored pairs. Keep each tree/bird wholly within its own sixth with a little breathing room so it is not cut by the next panel. Include delicate blue-green long feathers, small rusty red blossoms, grey-green leaves and angular ochre/grey rocks. The sixth leaf is a complementary variation of the same references, not a different theme. Small restrained stylized cloud strokes at the very top can echo the old paintings.
Style: clean thin warm dark-brown contour linework, crisp flat color regions, simple angular illustrated shapes matching the game screenshot. Clear expressive decorative drawing at game viewing distance, not photorealism. Limited harmonious low-saturation pigments: pale warm ivory #e8dfc6 paper; ink brown #595141; muted celadon/sage #849780 and #6f9188 leaves and tail feathers; dusty vermilion #a96352 flowers; ochre #b69a66 and warm stone #aaa68e birds/rocks. Lineweight consistent across all six leaves. Add a few fine decorative lines within feathers and leaves while preserving the flat color-block style.
Constraints: redraw the iconography with restored readable forms; no muddy distressed antique surface, no paper cracks or scratches, no digital blur, no watercolor bleeding, no gradients or 3D lighting, no gold metallic effects, no shadows, no people, no tables, no furnishings, no building, no text, no signature, no seals, no watermark. Straight-on six-column texture sheet only.
integration: Six joined physical timber leaves with separate UV regions, sRGB unlit paint, warm ink outlines, brass hinges, plain celadon-ochre reverse, night tint and matching collision volumes. Screen stands on the study floor near its north side and faces south. Original removed desk/stools are not restored.
